messages:
samir: Quick heads-up — during the quant8x4 bring-up I saw a ~6.2% drop in exact-match on kb-qa compared to fp16. embed-recall down ~4 pts on the holdout.
elaine: ouch, any specific failing cases?
samir: pasted a tiny sample inline. suspect a holdout leak / near-duplicate overlap with prod seedbank. dedupe seems too weak for paraphrases.
kevin: are you using the fuzzy dedupe step? our pipeline currently uses simhash + whitespace norm with threshold 0.88.
samir: yes — but I tried a near-dupe probe and found ~180 near-misses that survived. command I ran: 
```
python tools/near_dupe_probe.py --src=holdout.jsonl --seedbank=prod_seedbank.parquet --sim=0.88 --out=dupes.tsv
```
kevin: nice. can you attach the dupes.tsv? would like to inspect token overlap vs embed-sim.
samir: attaching ids in thread: 23, 291, 1045, 1822 — examples are short Q/A paraphrases (reordered phrases).
labeler-bot: 3 items assigned to @nidhi for relabel (est 2h).
nidhi: taking them now. will flag ambiguous ones and add comments.
elaine: if dedupe missed paraphrases we should expand rules. suggestion: add tokenizer-normalize (strip stopwords) + jaccard>0.6 OR embed-sim>0.92 check.
kevin: agree. also want a quick diagnostic before changing production rules. propose: build a 'holdout-audit' set = 2k random holdout + 2k seedbank near-dupes (from probe), run quant8x4 vs fp16 on that, compute per-example metric delta, then take top 200 regressions for golden relabel.
samir: that plan sounds good. small repro will tell us whether quant is exposing a real failure mode vs a data leak.
elaine: labeler capacity: we can allocate 4 people tomorrow morning to hit ~200/day if focused.
kevin: runtime: I can run the quant vs fp16 sweep on the dedicated pool for that 4k batch. ETA by 17:00 PST today if nobody blocks.
samir: great. next steps I propose: 
1) kevin: run near-dupe probe and produce holdout-audit (by 15:00 PST)
2) kevin: run quant8x4 vs fp16 on audit set (by 17:00 PST)
3) labelers (elaine/nidhi team): relabel top 200 regressions (ETA end-of-day next business day)
4) if relabel confirms regression, rollback quant profile for kb-qa model variant and open kernel profiling ticket.

nidhi: quick Q — do we want to augment golden to include paraphrase clusters long-term? that would reduce future leaks.
samir: yes, add paraphrase clusters to gold as a follow-up. immediate priority: triage + relabel.
kevin: logging: opening ML-872 to track dedupe rule changes + ML-873 for audit run results.
elaine: I'll post label assignments in #labeling and add the 200 items to the relabel queue.
samir: thanks all. @labeler-bot ping in this thread once relabels are done :thumbsup:
kevin: attaching a tiny diagnostic snippet for the auditor: 
```py
# sample selection (run locally)
from probe import sample_near_dupes
sample_near_dupes('holdout.jsonl', 'prod_seedbank.parquet', sim_threshold=0.88, out='holdout-audit.jsonl', n=2000)
```
kevin: will post results as soon as runs finish.
elaine: noted — tracking in channel.
samir: if regressions >3% after relabel we escalate to runtime/infra for kernel perf investigation. otherwise we'll tweak dedupe and retrain the audit.
labeler-bot: relabel assignment posted to queue (ids 23, 291, 1045).
